reviews.title: Impressed With the Lovi AI Skin Scanner!
reviews.text:
I’ve really enjoyed using the Lovi AI Skin Care Scanner. I love how it analyzes your skin and gives you a better understanding of the areas that may need a little more attention. It’s easy to use, informative, and I especially like that the recommendations feel personalized instead of having to guess which products or skincare routine might work for me.

It’s also interesting being able to track my skin and become more intentional about my skincare routine. So far, I’m impressed and excited to continue using it and see my progress over time!

reviews.title: AVOID THIS APP AT ALL COSTS
reviews.text:
This app is absolutely horrible. I tried multiple times to cancel my subscription following their exact instructions, and it never worked. The charges kept appearing on my credit card month after month with no way to stop them.

Customer support was completely useless and provided no real solution. The only way I was finally able to stop the charges was by cancelling my credit card entirely and getting a new one issued. That is completely unacceptable.

Avoid this app at all costs. A service that makes it this difficult to cancel and continues charging customers despite repeated cancellation attempts is not trustworthy.

reviews.title: Pricy but worth the investment.
reviews.text: I find this app very impressive. Navigating is easy, intuitive, and the layout is clean. No crashing or broken links (even to external sites). The imbedded AI is very insightful. Love the face scans to track progress or make it easier to understand what isn’t working. Wonderful product recommendations with links for easy purchase. Love the ability to filter product suggestions to fit different budgets. My only suggestions would be to add the ability to identify missed problem areas on face scans (due to poor lighting, etc.), a slider to fine tune suggested products based on how much you’re comfortable budgeting for skincare, the ability to save all products owned to your account, and be able to mark which products you used in the daily log. Overall, very useful and informative app.
